description: This header file declares the Telemetry class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, which implements plugin functionality for handling JSONRPC communication, report management, and possibly IARM bus initialization for the Telemetry plugin.

classes.name: Telemetry
classes.description: A plugin class that handles JSONRPC communication, report management, and IARM bus interactions within the WPEFramework.

methods.name: setReportProfileStatus
methods.description: Sets the report profile status based on provided JSON parameters.

methods.name: logApplicationEvent
methods.description: Logs an application event based on provided JSON parameters.

methods.name: uploadReport
methods.description: Uploads a report, possibly triggering the report upload process.

methods.name: InitializeIARM
methods.description: Initializes the IARM bus communication, conditionally compiled.

methods.name: DeinitializeIARM
methods.description: Deinitializes the IARM bus communication, conditionally compiled.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin with the provided service shell.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information as a string.

methods.name: onReportUploadStatus
methods.description: Handles status updates for report uploads; conditionally compiled.

methods.name: notifyT2PrivacyMode
methods.description: Notifies current privacy mode; conditionally compiled.
